$Comment: The chapter gate: the road south opens only once a player has put real hours in.
Two different measurements on purpose. The XP step counts what is earned while the quest is
carried, so it always takes some doing; the level step reads a standing value (the best single
skill a player has), so it can already be satisfied the moment the quest is taken.
REACH_LEVEL with a blank Target means 'any one skill'. Write a skill name for that skill, or
